6846.de: Full figure of a man with head turned to the right. Wearing a hat, chest bared, in knee-length trousers, feet bare. Holding a scythe up on the left, in the right hand some round object. The upper part of the background is blue, below a hilly landscape is vaguely visible.

8994.de: Bust portrait of a man with his head turned to the left. A rich wig falls onto the right shoulder, from the left side a lace jabot and a brocade waistcoat are visible. Over the right shoulder is thrown a green coat in brownish tones with brocade trimmings. As background, from behind a depicted curtain, an indistinct strip of landscape appears on the right.

25504.d: Graafiline leht allegoorilise stseeniga. Pilvedel istub suurem grupp naisi, igaühel käes embleem, mis iseloomustab üht teadus- või kunstiala. Keskel asuvad allegooriad: skulptuur vasara ja kujuga vapil, maalikunst pintslikimbuga, geomeetria sirkli, kolmnurga ja lineaaliga, muusika kandlega jne. Kõige kõrgemal seisab säravas valguses looriga kaetud naisfiguur, kellelt kroonitud noormees üritab loori ära rebida. Ülal, taga paistab joonia sammastega ümar ehitus. Vasakul ees pilvede all seisab grupp mehi, kes vaatavad üles ja pakuvad kandikul viirukinõud.(eesti)
25504.de: A print with an allegorical scene. On the clouds sits a large group of women, each holding an emblem characterising a field of science or art. In the centre are the allegories: Sculpture with a hammer and a figure on a coat of arms, Painting with a bundle of brushes, Geometry with a compass, a triangle and a ruler, Music with a kantele, etc. Highest of all stands, in bright light, a female figure covered with a veil, from whom a crowned young man tries to tear away the veil. Above, in the background, a round building with Ionic columns can be seen. On the left in front, beneath the clouds, stands a group of men who look up and offer a censer with incense on a tray.

29865.d: Maastikus heinavihku õlal kandva poisi figuur, pikas vööga seotud rõivas, laiaääreline kõrge põhjaga kaabu viljavihu peal. Taga meri, ees rannamaastik.
29865.de: In a landscape, the figure of a boy carrying a haystack bundle on his shoulder, dressed in a long belted garment, a wide-brimmed tall-crowned hat on top of the sheaf of grain. Behind, the sea, in front a coastal landscape.

64807.de:
A round platter on three leaf-shaped feet. On the bottom of the platter, on a shield-shaped gilded surface, an engraved group of rococo ornament, in the centre of which an emblem: compass, set square, plane, etc. Below, text: An(n)o 1775 d. 27.Sept. The platter's inner, wavy rim with fine profiling and rocailles above the feet.
On top, maker's mark IGD.

65041.de: A tureen, its low foot and lid are decorated with winding vertical grooves. At the top of the lid a decorative, roundly modelled rosebud, at the lower part of whose stem relief leaves attach to the lid. The oval serving plate has a wavy, profiled edge, the heart-shaped handles imitate a plant stem.

65360.de:
Compared with the data in the 2007 catalogue (Maarjamaa rococo. Gottlieb Welté (1745/49-1792): exhibition catalogue. Tallinn: Art Museum of Estonia, 2007), it is clear that Gottlieb Christian Welté's sepia drawing is an original work by Welté – a preparatory drawing for the 1774 aquatint "Pyramus and Thisbe".
The painter and etcher Gottlieb Christian Welté was born in 1747 in Wiesbaden (Biebrich), worked in Mainz and Frankfurt, came to Estonia to Põltsamaa Castle, and died at Lohu manor in 1792. With his small-format genre paintings and etchings he well suited the taste of the era.
Welté's oeuvre belongs to the stylistic period of transition from late Rococo to early Classicism. He brought to Estonian manor culture

65629.dm: lehe kõrgus: 16.3 cm; laius: 29.4 cm; kõrgus: 34.3 cm; lehe laius: 12.6 cm
65629.d: Maalikunstnik ja ofortist Gottlieb Christian Welté sündis 1747. aastal Wiesbadenis (Biebrichis), tegutses Mainzis ja Frankfurdis, tuli Eestisse Põltsamaa lossi ja suri Lohu mõisas 1792. aastal. Oma väikeseformaadiliste žanrimaalide ja ofortidega vastas ta hästi ajastu maitsele. Ka käesolev töö kujutab ajastule iseloomulikku intiimset stseeni armastajapaariga looduses. Eesti Kunstimuuseumis on Gottlieb Christian Welté teostest olemas mitu maali, üks ofort ja üks seepiajoonistus, millele antud joonistus on väärtuslikuks täienduseks. Teosele lisab väärtust ka ajastuomane vormistus.
65629.de: The painter and etcher Gottlieb Christian Welté was born in 1747 in Wiesbaden (Biebrich), worked in Mainz and Frankfurt, came to Estonia to Põltsamaa Castle, and died at Lohu Manor in 1792. With his small-format genre paintings and etchings he well matched the taste of his era. This work, too, depicts an intimate scene with a pair of lovers in nature, characteristic of the period. The Art Museum of Estonia holds several paintings, one etching and one sepia drawing by Gottlieb Christian Welté, to which this drawing is a valuable addition. The work's value is further enhanced by its period-appropriate framing.
